create_kneighbors_regressor: create a KNeighborsRegressor to predict continuous targets using k-nearest neighbor interpolation
fit_kneighbors_regressor: fit a KNeighborsRegressor model on training data with configurable n_neighbors and distance metric
predict_kneighbors_regressor: predict continuous target values using a fitted KNeighborsRegressor with uniform or distance weights
create_radius_neighbors_regressor: create a RadiusNeighborsRegressor to predict targets using neighbors within a fixed radius
predict_radius_neighbors_regressor: predict continuous target values using a fitted RadiusNeighborsRegressor with radius-based neighborhood
